summary: Independent verification of Checkpoint D bug fix — signer title under 'Adjimon Kouatonou' on all offer letter PDF variants now renders 'Human Resources (HR) Manager' and no longer contains 'Chief Executive Officer (CEO)'. Wrote 10-test suite covering the API branding read/write merge, seed guard regression, and PyMuPDF-based text extraction of all five variants (original, rescinded, expired, declined, accepted). Also re-ran the four existing offer regression suites (63 passed / 1 skipped, identical to main agent's baseline).
critical_code_review_comments: routes/careers_offers.py line 463: `signer_title = branding.get('signer_title') or 'Human Resources (HR) Manager'` — fallback is safe; production path is fed by the 3-layer branding merge (offer_branding wins) so admin PUT value is authoritative.

routes/careers_offers.py line 1279: seed-demo canonical still defaults `signer_title` to 'Chief Executive Officer (CEO)' when `CERTIFICATE_SIGNER_ROLE` is empty. Not a functional bug because the seed guard (lines 1291-1301) short-circuits with `skipped: admin_already_customized` when admin has set any non-canonical value — verified in TestSeedGuardRegression. Consider updating the fallback to match line 463 ('Human Resources (HR) Manager') for consistency.

Learning Hub certificates intentionally keep `CERTIFICATE_SIGNER_ROLE='Chief Executive Officer (CEO)'` — flagged in the request as OUT OF SCOPE and confirmed present in routes/ai_learning_hub.py; no change recommended.
seed_data_creation: None. TestOfferBrandingPreservation temporarily PUTs `company_info` to a marker value and restores it. TestSeedGuardRegression only reads back; verified admin-set signer_title survives (seed skips with `admin_already_customized`).
context_for_next_testing_agent: The offer letter signer title fix (iter 876) is verified end-to-end: DB→API→PDF text. Full test suite at /app/backend/tests/test_offer_letter_hr_signer_title_iter876.py can be re-run standalone. The review-email endpoint (POST /api/careers/offers/letters/review-email) was intentionally NOT triggered during this run to avoid sending duplicate real emails to admin — main agent already invoked it once (delivered 05:30Z) and its coverage is validated by TestReviewEmailEndpoint in the existing pack suite (still green). If the seed default at line 1279 is later changed to 'Human Resources (HR) Manager' for consistency, TestSeedGuardRegression will still pass.
